summary: Wizards are magical Characters who combine reliable Spell Attacks with offensive, defensive, or utility Arcana.

units.name: Wizard

options.name: Wizard
options.notes: Primary Spell is selected from primarySpell; Wizard uses printed values, Master Wizard adds +2 inches normal Range and improves Hit by one step (maximum 2+) for that primary spell. This bonus applies only to the selected primary spell, not Arcana learned separately.

options.name: Master Wizard
options.tagChange: Loses Elite tag and gains Hero.
options.notes: Primary Spell is selected from primarySpell; Wizard uses printed values, Master Wizard adds +2 inches normal Range and improves Hit by one step (maximum 2+) for that primary spell. This bonus applies only to the selected primary spell, not Arcana learned separately.

meleeWeaponOptions.note: Wizards carry exactly one primary Spell Attack, alongside their selected melee weapon; optional learned offensive Arcana remain alternative Assault Attacks.

masterWizardAbility.name: Arcane Mastery
masterWizardAbility.effect: When this Model's Spell Attack generates a Surge, one target of that Attack suffers Direct Damage 1 after the Attack resolves. This additional Damage does not replace normal Hits or Damage. Applicable Ward Saves still apply.

options.name: Standard Arcana
options.effect: Know the number of Arcana provided by the Wizard specialization.

options.name: Additional Arcana
options.effect: Learn one additional Arcana. Increases spell options, not CP or Doctrine-card availability.

options.name: Arcane Training
options.effect: Gain Accurate +1 on offensive spell attacks.

options.name: Weapon Specialization
options.effect: Choose one Faction, Unit Type, or Trait tag. One offensive Spell Attack (including the selected primary spell) gains Anti-[chosen tag] 2 against eligible targets; the highest matching Anti rank applies.

options.name: Veteran
options.effect: Choose one offensive Spell Attack (including the selected primary spell): increase its Attacks by 1 and improve Hit by one step.

options.name: Cantrip
options.effect: Reduce the CP cost of this Model's first eligible Command each Round by 1 (minimum 0). No card is exhausted for a 0 CP use.

options.name: Greater Ward
options.effect: This unit's Ward improves by 1. This includes both Physical and Magic.

options.name: Precision Casting
options.effect: Choose one Spell Attack this Wizard knows. It gains Pinpoint, ignoring the shooting-into-Engagement Hit penalty and friendly-fire Direct Damage from Blunders; it does not suppress other Blunders or Blast.

options.name: Critical Channeling
options.effect: Choose one offensive Spell Attack; it gains Critical 1 per Surge on failed Hit dice, with Ward still applicable. This printed/passive benefit is not guaranteed without a Surge.

genericArcana.note: The primary spell is included at no Arcana cost; alternative offensive spell profiles may be learned using Arcana selections, with CP Command choices competing for the same known Arcana slots.

offensive.name: Arcane Bolt
offensive.effect: Reliable, repeatable magical bolts. May be learned as additional offensive Arcana if Arcane Bolt is not the Wizard's free Primary Spell.

offensive.name: Arcane Blast
offensive.effect: Area magic that inflicts an automatic Hit on other Units within 1" of the target if the Attack scores a Hit.

command.note: Command Arcana require their listed CP cost; a Command card represents that CP in matched play and is not an additional cost.

options.name: Arcane Ward
options.effect: Grant Ward 6+ to one friendly Unit within Short, or improve its existing Ward by one step.

options.name: Haste
options.effect: One friendly Unit within Short gains +2" Move until the end of the Round.

options.name: Hex
options.effect: Worsen one visible enemy's Armor or Evade by one step until the end of the Round.

options.name: Slow
options.effect: One visible enemy within Medium suffers Slow 2, reducing its next Move by 2".

options.name: Teleport
options.effect: Move one friendly Unit within Short up to 3". It cannot finish Engaged.

options.name: Dispel
options.effect: When an enemy within Medium uses a magical Command Ability, roll a D6. On 4+, that ability fails.

options.name: Arcane Rupture
options.effect: Choose one visible enemy unit within Medium. On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 2. Applicable Ward Saves still apply.

options.name: Arcane Storm
options.effect: Instead of moving this Phase, place a 25mm token within Medium of this unit. At the end of the Round, each Unit with at least half its surviving Models within 2" suffers 3 separate automatic Magic Hits at Damage 1 total; Armor and Ward apply, Evade does not. Do not multiply Hits by Models. Remove the token after resolving this effect.

units.battlefieldRole: Magical attacks, battlefield manipulation, utility, and supporting troops through specialized spells.
designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 Attacks (Arcane Bolt, Staff/Dagger, Arcane Blade, Battle Staff, Arcane Blast, Force Bolt) gained +1 Attack; the Damage-2 Arcane Lance kept its listed Attacks and gained Anti-Monster 2.

v4.1 refinement: the Wizard is a single Model, so Veteran (+50) stays a flat cost rather than the higher per-unit pricing used on larger multi-Model formations like Line/Ranged Infantry. A new Weapon Specialization upgrade (+25) lets the Wizard choose any Faction/Unit Type/Trait tag for one offensive Arcana to gain Anti-[chosen tag] 2.

primarySpell.note: Every Wizard chooses exactly one free primary Spell Attack from Arcane Bolt, Arcane Blast, Force Bolt, or Arcane Lance. Additional offensive spell profiles may be learned through Arcana slots. Each spell is an alternative normal Assault Attack; never combine their Attack dice.
